content.comment_body: Hello, Is it possible to connect a 0-10V DC signal as an analog input on either I7 or I8 of a [product_name]? If so, could you please point me to some relevant [document]? Thank you, [user_name].
A [product_name] 230 VAC does not have analog inputs built in.

analysis.insight_summary: The conversation focuses on the lack of onboard analog input capability for the [product_name] variant, which might lead to confusion among users who expect standard analog input options.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates that the [product_name] will allow direct connection of 0-10V DC analog signals on standard inputs (I7/I8) and requests clear documentation confirming this capability.
